scripts.test: echo '── CHAIN=bsc' && CHAIN=bsc npm run --silent test:target && echo '── CHAIN=robinhood' && CHAIN=robinhood npm run --silent test:target

scripts.check:bsc: npm run test:chain-check && CHAIN=bsc tsx scripts/chain-check.ts

// overrides: rainbowkit -> cuer@0.0.3 renders every QR with `border: 0`, but it asks npm for `qr: "~0"` — which floats to ANY 0.x. qr@0.6.0 started rejecting border <= 0, so the QR component throws on render, the error escapes React, and the WHOLE APP unmounts to a black screen the moment you pick a WalletConnect-backed wallet. Latent until 2026-07-23: a dead projectId meant we never reached the QR. cuer@0.0.3 and rainbowkit@2.2.11 are both latest — nothing upstream to upgrade to, so pin the last qr that accepts border=0.
